# Chat, OBS, speech and sounds

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

## SendMessage

Sends a message in your Twitch chat. Cuebot sends it with its connected Twitch account; the bot and fallback settings are ignored. Empty text sends nothing.

```csharp
void SendMessage(string message, bool bot = true, bool fallback = true)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SendMessage("Thanks for the follow!");
```

## SendYouTubeMessage

Sends a message in your YouTube chat. Give a broadcast id to post in that stream's chat, with the bot account (or the broadcaster as fallback). Empty text sends nothing.

```csharp
void SendYouTubeMessage(string message, bool bot = true, bool fallback = true, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SendYouTubeMessage("Welcome to the stream!");
```

## SendKickMessage

Sends a message in your Kick chat. The bot and fallback settings are ignored. Empty text sends nothing.

```csharp
void SendKickMessage(string message, bool bot = true, bool fallback = true)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SendKickMessage("Thanks for the follow!");
```

## SendMessageToAll

Sends the same message to every chat that is connected right now (Twitch, YouTube, Kick and others). A Cuebot extra. Fails when no chat is connected.

```csharp
void SendMessageToAll(string message)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SendMessageToAll("Going live in 5 minutes!");
```

## ObsIsConnected

Checks whether OBS answers right now. Give a connection number to check another OBS; 0 is the default one.

```csharp
bool ObsIsConnected(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** true when OBS answered, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool connected = CPH.ObsIsConnected();
CPH.LogInfo($"OBS connected: {connected}");
```

## ObsSetScene

Switches OBS to another scene, by its name exactly as OBS shows it. The connection number picks another OBS (0 is the default).

```csharp
void ObsSetScene(string sceneName, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsSetScene("Gameplay");
```

## ObsGetCurrentScene

Asks OBS which scene is live right now.

```csharp
string ObsGetCurrentScene(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** The scene's name, or empty text when OBS did not say.

**Example**

```csharp
string scene = CPH.ObsGetCurrentScene();
CPH.LogInfo($"Live scene: {scene}");
```

## ObsSetSourceVisibility

Shows (true) or hides (false) a source in an OBS scene. Fails when the scene has no source with that name.

```csharp
void ObsSetSourceVisibility(string scene, string source, bool visible, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsSetSourceVisibility("Gameplay", "Webcam", true);
```

## ObsShowSource

Shows a source in an OBS scene, like your webcam. Fails when the scene has no source with that name.

```csharp
void ObsShowSource(string scene, string source, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsShowSource("Gameplay", "Webcam");
```

## ObsHideSource

Hides a source in an OBS scene. Fails when the scene has no source with that name.

```csharp
void ObsHideSource(string scene, string source, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsHideSource("Gameplay", "Webcam");
```

## ObsIsSourceVisible

Checks whether a source in an OBS scene is showing.

```csharp
bool ObsIsSourceVisible(string scene, string source, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** true when the source is visible, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool visible = CPH.ObsIsSourceVisible("Gameplay", "Webcam");
CPH.LogInfo($"Webcam visible: {visible}");
```

## ObsToggleSource

Flips a source in an OBS scene: hides it when it shows, shows it when it is hidden.

```csharp
void ObsToggleSource(string scene, string source, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsToggleSource("Gameplay", "Webcam");
```

## ObsShowFilter

Turns on a filter in OBS. Give a scene or source name and the filter name. The version with scene and source turns on the source's filter (the scene is not used).

```csharp
void ObsShowFilter(string sourceName, string filterName, int connection = 0)
void ObsShowFilter(string scene, string source, string filterName, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsShowFilter("Gameplay", "Webcam", "Blur");
```

## ObsHideFilter

Turns off a filter in OBS. Give a scene or source name and the filter name. The version with scene and source turns off the source's filter (the scene is not used).

```csharp
void ObsHideFilter(string sourceName, string filterName, int connection = 0)
void ObsHideFilter(string scene, string source, string filterName, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsHideFilter("Gameplay", "Webcam", "Blur");
```

## ObsSetGdiText

Changes the words in an OBS text source. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

```csharp
void ObsSetGdiText(string scene, string source, string text, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsSetGdiText("Gameplay", "Death Counter", "Deaths: 7");
```

## ObsSetBrowserSource

Points an OBS browser source at a new web link. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

```csharp
void ObsSetBrowserSource(string scene, string source, string url, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsSetBrowserSource("Gameplay", "Alerts", "https://example.com/alerts");
```

## ObsSetImageSourceFile

Shows a different picture file in an OBS image source. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

```csharp
void ObsSetImageSourceFile(string scene, string source, string file, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsSetImageSourceFile("Gameplay", "Emote", @"C:\Stream\Images\hype.png");
```

## ObsSetMediaSourceFile

Loads a different video or sound file in an OBS media source. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

```csharp
void ObsSetMediaSourceFile(string scene, string source, string file, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsSetMediaSourceFile("Gameplay", "Clip Player", @"C:\Stream\Clips\win.mp4");
```

## ObsIsStreaming

Checks whether OBS is live right now.

```csharp
bool ObsIsStreaming(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** true while OBS is streaming, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool live = CPH.ObsIsStreaming();
CPH.LogInfo($"OBS live: {live}");
```

## ObsIsRecording

Checks whether OBS is recording right now.

```csharp
bool ObsIsRecording(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** true while OBS is recording, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool recording = CPH.ObsIsRecording();
CPH.LogInfo($"OBS recording: {recording}");
```

## ObsSendRaw

Sends any OBS request by its name, with its data written as JSON text. For advanced users who know the obs-websocket requests.

```csharp
string ObsSendRaw(string requestType, string data, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** OBS's answer as JSON text.

**Example**

```csharp
string answer = CPH.ObsSendRaw("GetSceneList", "{}");
CPH.LogInfo(answer);
```

## TtsSpeak

Says a message out loud with one of your text-to-speech voices, picked by its alias from the Speech page. Tick the bad word filter to clean up the text first.

```csharp
int TtsSpeak(string voiceAlias, string message, bool badWordFilter = false)
```

**Gives back:** Always 0.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.TtsSpeak("Brian", "Welcome to the stream!");
```

## PlaySound

Plays a sound file. Volume goes from 0 to 1. With finishBeforeContinuing true, your code waits until the sound ends. The sound name (or file name) lets StopSoundPlayback stop it.

```csharp
double PlaySound(string fileName, float volume = 1.0f, bool finishBeforeContinuing = false, string? soundName = null, bool useFileName = true)
```

**Gives back:** Always 0.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.PlaySound(@"C:\Stream\Sounds\airhorn.mp3", 0.5f);
```

## StopSoundPlayback

Stops the sounds playing with this name. The name is the sound name you gave PlaySound, or the file name without its ending.

```csharp
void StopSoundPlayback(string soundName)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StopSoundPlayback("airhorn");
```

## StopAllSoundPlayback

Stops every sound that is playing right now.

```csharp
void StopAllSoundPlayback()
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StopAllSoundPlayback();
```

## DiscordPostTextToWebhook

Posts a message to a Discord channel through a webhook link. You can set the name and picture it posts with, and tick text-to-speech. Fails when Discord refuses.

```csharp
string DiscordPostTextToWebhook(string webhookUrl, string content, string? username = null, string? avatarUrl = null, bool textToSpeech = false)
```

**Gives back:** The new message's id, or empty text when Discord did not say.

**Example**

```csharp
string id = CPH.DiscordPostTextToWebhook("https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123/abc", "We are live!", "Stream Bot");
CPH.LogInfo($"Posted message {id}");
```
